description: Runs a 3D finite-element frame analysis and returns the numbers: equilibrium check, largest deflection along the members, largest joint displacement and sway in X and Y, every support reaction, the axial force, shears and moments of every member (the envelope with the governing combination when there are several), and natural periods with mass participation (modal analysis); linear or second order (P-Delta). The model is either a template (a pitched portal frame building, an open mono-pitch canopy, or a multi-storey frame, from a few dimensions, sections and loads) or a full model in JSON (nodes, members, sections, supports, loads, combinations). It is solved by the code of Structomat's free 3D frame analysis page, so the result also has a link that shows the same model and results in 3D (deflected shape, force diagrams, mode shapes). Use it to check a frame, compare sections or see how loads flow, and run it again with changed sections or loads. The result also has a preliminary member check to AISC 360-16 LRFD (results.member_check): the demand-to-capacity ratio of each member with the governing check, combination and point, for IPE, HEA, HEB, CHS and SHS sections and I or tube sections with dimensions; effective length factor K = 1 and unbraced length Lb = member length unless set (beam_unbraced_m, column_unbraced_m, or "check" on a model member). The forces are elastic second order without notional loads or stiffness reduction (not the direct analysis method): K = 1 holds only when the second-order sway is at most 1.1 times the linear sway, otherwise K must come from a stability analysis; a linear run gives no valid check; connections, seismic provisions and fire are not covered, and code load combinations only through combination_set. The model is not stored.

bay_x_m.description: storey: bay width in X, m.

bay_z_m.description: storey: bay width in Y, m.

bays_z.description: storey: bays in Y (the second horizontal direction; Z is vertical).

beam_unbraced_m.description: portal, mono, storey: unbraced length Lb of the beams / rafters for lateral-torsional buckling in the member check, m (spacing of purlins or other restraints of the compression flange; default the member length).

brace_section.description: portal, mono: hollow section for the bracing (default CHS 139.7x5).

column_unbraced_m.description: portal, mono, storey: unbraced length Lb of the columns in the member check, m (spacing of girts or other restraints; default the member length).

column_web.description: Direction of the column webs: x (default) = strong axis resists sway in X, the frame direction; y = strong axis resists sway in Y.

combination_set.description: single (default) = one combination with the factors given; en = a typical EN 1990 ultimate set (expression 6.10); asce = ASCE 7 LRFD basic combinations. en and asce are solved as an envelope.

dead_kN_m2.description: Dead load on roof/floor, kN/m2 (self-weight of members is added).

high_height_m.description: mono: height of the high side, m.

leeward_kN_m2.description: portal, storey: leeward suction, kN/m2 (not used for mono).

low_height_m.description: mono: height of the low side, m.

modal.description: Also run a modal analysis: natural periods, mode shapes and mass participation (default true).

modal_live_share.description: Share of the live or snow load in the modal mass, psi (default 0.3); mass = self-weight + dead + psi x live.

model.description: Instead of a template: a full model, units kN and m, Z vertical. {"up":"Z", "nodes":{"N1":[x,y,z],...}, "members":[{"id":"M1","i":"N1","j":"N2","sec":"S1","rot":0,"pinned":false}], "sections":{"S1":{"A":m2,"Iy":m4 weak,"Iz":m4 strong,"J":m4}}, "supports":{"N1":"fixed"|"pinned"}, "nodeLoads":[{"node":"N2","case":"G"|"Q"|"W","F":[Fx,Fy,Fz]}], "memberLoads":[{"member":"M1","case":"G","dir":"FX"|"FY"|"FZ","w":kN_per_m}], "combos":[{"name":"ULS1","factors":{"G":1.35,"Q":1.5}}], "selfWeight":true, "analysis":"pdelta"|"linear", "modal":{"modes":12,"G":1,"Q":0.3}}. Load cases may have any name; several combinations are solved and shown with their envelope (a single "combo":{...} is still accepted). Gravity loads act in -FZ. A member load may vary from w to w2 between x1 and x2 (m from the i end). "pinned": true releases bending at both ends, "i" or "j" at one end. The modal mass may use any load case, e.g. {"modes":12,"G":1,"S":0.3}. A vertical member has its web (local axis 2) along X; "rot":90 turns it to Y. Without "up":"Z" the older format with Y vertical is read and converted. Steel E = 210 GPa. Member check: give each section a standard "name" (e.g. "HEA 300", "CHS 139.7x5", "SHS 100x100x5") or it is analysed but not checked; a member may carry "check":{"Lcx":m,"Lcy":m,"Lcz":m,"Lb":m} (Lcx about the strong axis, Lcz torsional, default the member length); a member with a free end is checked as a cantilever (Cb = 1.0).

ridge_rise_m.description: portal: ridge rise above eave, m.

span_m.description: portal (4-60) or mono (3-30): frame span, m.

steel_grade.description: Steel for the member check: S235, S275, S355 (default; S..H for tubes) or ASTM (A992 for I-sections, A500 Gr. C for tubes).

template.description: portal = pitched portal frame building; mono = open mono-pitch canopy; storey = multi-storey frame. Omit when sending model.

wind_direction.description: portal, storey: x (default) = wind on the long wall / the face at X = 0; y = wind on the gable / the face at Y = 0; xy = both together in the same combination (conservative).

wind_kN_m2.description: portal, storey: wind pressure on the windward face (see wind_direction); mono: net wind pressure on the roof, positive upward (uplift); kN/m2.

name: analyze_frame
title: Analyze a 3D steel frame (finite elements, returns the numbers)
